title: I wish, even if
goal: Wish and regret with keşke, hope with umarım, and say even if with -sA bile and -sA dA.

intro.text: *Keşke* (I wish) takes `-sA` for now and `-sAydI` for the past: *Keşke burada olsan*, *Keşke gelseydim*. Add *bile* or *dA* after an if-clause for **even if**: *Yağmur yağsa bile gideceğiz*.

vocab.en: even (yağsa bile: even if it rains)
what a pity, too bad (çok yazık: what a shame)

exercises.question: Which sentence is a regret about the past?

why.1: *Çalışsam* wishes about now: **I wish I worked harder**.
why.2: *Umarım* hopes for the future: **I hope I'll work harder**.

exercises.explain: `-sAydI` after *keşke* looks back: **I wish I had worked (or studied) harder**.

exercises.en: I wish you were here too.
exercises.explain: *Keşke* takes the conditional: *olsan*. *Olursan* is a real condition, and *keşke* never takes `-DI`.

exercises.prompt: I wish I knew more languages.

accept: I wish I had believed you that day.
I wish I'd believed you that day.
If only [I had|I'd] believed you that day.
I wish [I had|I'd] believed you on that day.
If only [I had|I'd] believed you on that day.

exercises.label: *Keşke* + *yapmamak*: if only I hadn't done it, if only you hadn't…
exercises.explain: Negative *-ma*, then *-sa-y-dı* and the ending: *yap-ma-sa-y-dı-m*. Back vowels throughout.

exercises.en: I hope the weather is nice tomorrow.

exercises.question: Your friend has an exam tomorrow. What do you say?

why.1: *Keşke … geçseydin* regrets a past result: **I wish you had passed**.

exercises.explain: A real hope about the future takes *umarım* and an ordinary tense: *geçersin*.

exercises.en: Even if it rains, we'll go for a walk.

reject.why: *DA* follows the last vowel of *yağsa*, a back a: *da*.

exercises.hint: One word for **even**, or the particle of *ben de*.
exercises.explain: *-sA bile* and *-sA dA* both mean **even if**. *DA* is written apart.

exercises.prompt: Even if you don't come, we'll go.
exercises.explain: *Gelmesen bile* or *gelmesen de*: **even if you don't come**.

exercises.prompt: Çok çalışsa bile o sınavı geçemez.
accept: Even if he studies hard, he cannot pass that exam.
Even if he studies hard, he will not be able to pass that exam.
Even if he [works hard|studies a lot|works a lot], he [cannot|will not be able to] pass that exam.
Even if she [studies|works] [hard|a lot], she [cannot|will not be able to] pass that exam.
Even if he [studied|worked] [hard|a lot], he [could not|would not be able to] pass that exam.
Even if she [studied|worked] [hard|a lot], she [could not|would not be able to] pass that exam.

exercises.prompt: Whether it rains or not, we're going.
exercises.text: Yağmur yağsa da yağmasa da gidiyoruz.

exercises.en: I wish you had told me too.

reject.why: *Keşke beğensen* doubts it: **if only you liked it**. A real hope takes *umarım*.
